description: Shows what a batch of settings changes would do and writes nothing: for each account and cell the current value and the new value, warnings (for example no posting time left), and row errors (an account that is not this member's, an unknown column, a value outside the allowed range, a cell changed since it was read). Takes changes as a list of { account_id, set, base } or csv in the same format as the website download. The result carries apply_changes and a preview_id valid for 15 minutes, which apply_account_settings takes as they are. Applies before any bulk change, so the user sees the exact cells first. 繁中：預覽批次變更，逐格列出舊值與新值，什麼都不寫。

changes.description: Up to 100 entries: { account_id, set: { column: value }, base?: { column: value you saw } }. Columns and allowed values: list_account_settings columns, or https://mindthread.tw/accounts/bulk/rules

base.description: column key → value you read; a cell changed since then is refused instead of overwritten

csv.description: Instead of changes: a CSV in the website download format (UTF-8), up to 1 MB

name: preview_account_settings
title: Preview bulk settings changes
